semiconductor_relevance: High - RESER provides essential refurbishment and repair services for wafer handling equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: RESER is a total supplier specializing in the refurbishment, repair, and technical support of wafer handling equipment such as robots, pre-aligners, and load ports. With a commitment to quality and sustainability, RESER supports the entire lifecycle of semiconductor equipment, ensuring optimal performance and reliability for its customers.
capabilities: Repair of pre-aligners and robot controllers

regional_presence.Netherlands: RESER has a base in the Netherlands, supporting customers across Europe.
regional_presence.United States: The company also operates in the United States, providing services to local clients.
regional_presence.Asia: RESER extends its support to customers in Asia, enhancing its global reach.
